rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for someone energetic, initiative-taking, and willing to make things happen.

example.english: They saw a vacant shop and immediately planned to rent it for a café—really enterprising.
example.traditional: 佢一見到間舖頭有空位，就即刻諗住租落嚟做咖啡店，真係好有闖勁。

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is on ambition and striving for advancement, especially in work or business.

example.english: They are very enterprising at work and actively seek promotion every year.
example.traditional: 佢做嘢好進取，年年都主動爭取升職。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zou6 je5 hou2 zeon3 ceoi2 nin4 nin4 dou1 zyu2 dung6 zang1 ceoi2 sing1 zik1

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is on bravery and daring rather than business ability or ambition.

example.english: They were enterprising enough to stand up and speak the truth in front of so many people.
example.traditional: 佢夠膽喺咁多人面前企出嚟講真話，真係好有膽識。
